d:
Ansar Allah has released raw, unfiltered footage showing fighting in several locations east of Raghwan district in Yemen's Marib governorate. The footage purportedly shows Houthi fighters in action as the group claims to have driven Saudi-backed forces out of multiple positions. The latest battlefield footage offers a glimpse into the fighting in Marib, a strategically significant region in Yemen's ongoing conflict.
Produced & Edited By Ankit Kumar
